 Dated this the 26th day of August 2016
When this matter has been taken up for hearing, the learned counsel for the revision petitioners has submitted that he is not pressing this revision petition for hearing on merits.
In the result, this revision petition stands dismissed as not pressed.

However, the dismissal of this revision petition will not preclude the revision petitioners from adducing evidence to prove that the petitioners are entitled to the protection under Section 19(2) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 at the stage of defence evidence under Section 247 of the Code.

Sd/-
